basics.name: Isaac Legred
basics.summary: Currently a postdoctoral researcher at the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, working on neutron star astrophysics and gravitational-wave data analysis.

publications.name: Implicit correlations within phenomenological parametric models of the neutron star equation of state
publications.summary: Parametric models impose hidden correlations across density scales in neutron star EOS inference.

publications.name: Assessing equation of state-independent relations for neutron stars with nonparametric models
publications.summary: Re-evaluates universal NS relations (e.g. I-Love-Q) using flexible Gaussian-process EOS models.

publications.name: Simulating neutron stars with a flexible enthalpy-based equation of state parametrization in SpECTRE
publications.summary: Introduces an enthalpy-based EOS parametrization implemented in SpECTRE simulations of neutron stars.

publications.name: Phase transition phenomenology with nonparametric representations of the neutron star equation of state
publications.summary: Explores potential phase-transition behavior in dense matter with nonparametric EOS models.

publications.name: Using equation of state constraints to classify low-mass compact binary mergers
publications.summary: Classifies whether low-mass merger components are NS or BH using tidal/ EOS inference.

publications.name: Nonlinear Alfvén-wave dynamics and premerger emission from crustal oscillations in neutron star mergers
publications.summary: Simulates Alfvén waves from tidal excitations, predicting electromagnetic precursors before NS mergers.

publications.name: The interplay of astrophysics and nuclear physics in determining the properties of neutron stars
publications.summary: Joint inference of EOS and population differences between Galactic and GW observed neutron stars.

publications.name: Nonparametric extensions of nuclear equations of state: probing the breakdown scale of relativistic mean-field theory
publications.summary: Hybrid GP + relativistic mean-field hybrid EOS models to study breakdown scales via future observations.

publications.name: Unified nonparametric equation-of-state inference from the neutron-star crust to perturbative-QCD densities
publications.summary: Integrates pQCD constraints into a GP-based EOS extending from crust through ultra-high densities.

publications.name: Inferring the neutron star equation of state with nuclear-physics informed semiparametric models
publications.summary: Combines nuclear-physics meta-model at low density with GP at high density to infer NS EOS from multi-messenger data.

publications.name: Neutron Stars: Robust Constraints on Dense Matter from Astrophysics
publications.publisher: Ph.D. Dissertation, California Institute of Technology
publications.summary: Ph.D. thesis summarizing Legred’s work using electromagnetic and gravitational-wave observations to constrain dense-matter EOS using nonparametric models.
